claim_limit: A contract-valid revision is not an effective Skill. This is the final LLM proposal for the current residual-representation development family.

llm_plan.diagnosis: The rejected patch treated phase-aligned historical transport plus one current positive Support response as decision-sufficient, but replay shows that same evidence pattern can precede either harmful or supported execution.
llm_plan.expected_behavior_change: Cases with only historical transport plus a single positive Support response no longer execute; execution remains possible when independent split current Support agreement and regime stability both confirm an existing action.
llm_plan.falsification_condition: An observable replay in which all split support agreement and regime stability guards pass but the executed existing action is harmful, or a supported replay with all guards passing is abstained.
risk_guards: ABSTAIN if fewer than two current Target Support units are available.
ABSTAIN if the split current support views do not agree on the same existing action.
ABSTAIN if split current support agreement does not match the phase-aligned historical policy direction.
ABSTAIN if regime stability is not confirmed before execution.
ABSTAIN if no existing admissible action remains after ordering.

workflow_steps.behavior: Load the admissible training cutoff, phase alignment, and existing program-family eligibility without reading query future.
Retain only pre-cutoff phase-aligned historical policy episodes for the existing candidate actions.
Collect two bounded current Target Support units for the eligible candidate action set.
Partition the two current Target Support units into disjoint support views before making an execution decision.
Require both split current support views to agree with each other and with the phase-aligned historical policy direction for the same existing action.
Require the training context and phase-aligned historical policy episodes to indicate a stable admissible regime for the agreed existing action.
Order only existing admissible actions that passed split support agreement and regime stability.
Execute the top ordered existing action only when all prior checks pass.
Otherwise abstain from adaptation and allow the existing raw-target fallback path.

scientific_role: one bounded revision from post-proposal negative evidence
